column4: Pixel-art game sprites in the style of 1990s Build-engine games (Duke Nukem 3D, Redneck Rampage): chunky visible pixels, a limited muted palette, strong simple shading. Four separate small objects in a row with wide space between them, each seen flat from the side: a short broken dry twig with two little side branches, a loose tuft of dry yellow straw and grass blades, a torn scrap of yellowed newspaper with smudged grey print, a crumpled brown paper sweet wrapper. On a flat solid pure magenta #FF00FF background everywhere around them, no shadows on the ground, no text labels, not cute.

Pixel-art game sprites in the style of 1990s Build-engine games (Duke Nukem 3D, Redneck Rampage): chunky visible pixels, a limited muted palette. Four separate soft ragged puffs of dry brownish-grey dust blown sideways by the wind, each a different shape, thin and see-through looking at the frayed edges, denser in the middle, in a row with wide space between them, on a flat solid pure magenta #FF00FF background everywhere around them, no ground, no text.
